blocks.text: Rollback mechanisms ensure stability when updating
plugins. They let you revert to a previous version if updates cause bugs or issues, minimizing downtime and improving user experience.

Rollback systems are critical for smooth updates and user satisfaction. Choose a solution that fits your needs - whether it's Capgo's simplicity or the manual flexibility of the Live Update Plugin.
, rollback mechanisms work as a safeguard by keeping version backups and automatically restoring the previous stable version if something goes wrong. Here's how it works:
: Before applying an update, the system saves a copy of the current stable version.
: After the update, the system checks to ensure everything is working correctly.
: If the update fails the health check, the system reverts back to the backup version.
"One-click rollback to any previous version if needed" – Capgo

Rollbacks are essential when an update causes problems like critical bugs, slower performance, version conflicts, integration issues, or major user complaints. Capgo reports that 82% of updates succeed globally
, but for the remaining cases, having a reliable rollback system is crucial to fix issues quickly.

Integrate version tracking into your deployment process and establish restore points for quick reversion. Data from Capgo shows this strategy can cut downtime by up to 85% during critical failures
Include error tracking, user feedback, performance metrics, and update status monitoring to ensure smooth operations.

Even with careful testing, certain challenges can crop up during rollbacks:
: Managing multiple versions can be tricky. Keep track of bundle versions, API compatibility, database schemas, and asset mapping to avoid clashes.
: Clear out caches during rollbacks to ensure the system returns to a clean state.
: Make sure user data and app states are preserved during rollbacks. Data migration strategies should handle any changes between versions effectively.
